title: Electric Co-op Boundaries
description:
This layer contains boundaries of NM electric cooperatives. Included in this layer are attributes for co-op name (Kit Carson, Otero, etc.) and service distinction (whether the co-op is an ISP, grant-funded, or not offering broadband).

This layer was initially assembled by Brian Keller (EDAC) and later modified with new boundary data received from Carmen Campbell (NM Rural Electric Cooperative Association) on 1/30/2025.
snippet: New Mexico Electric Coop Boundaries. Last modified 3/14/2025, via new boundary information received on 1/30/2025.
